atoms.statement: Use YOLOv11x as the target model, explicitly configured and verified.
atoms.test: Verify `model_file` in config points to `yolo11x.pt` and logs confirm `yolo11x` loaded.

atoms.statement: Perform before/after comparison on the same recorded clip from real camera device 0 to ensure fair, reproducible results.
atoms.test: Verify that the same raw video clip from device 0 is used as input for both baseline and yolo11x inference runs.

atoms.statement: Conduct a separate live validation run on device 0 to confirm error-free real-time processing.
atoms.test: Execute yolo11x live on device 0 and confirm continuous, error-free frame processing for a defined duration.

atoms.statement: Optimize the confidence threshold using quantitative methods (e.g., F1/PR curve analysis, grid-search) on a labeled validation set, rather than manual tuning.
atoms.test: Document the method (e.g., F1 sweep, grid-search) and the labeled dataset used for confidence threshold optimization, showing the chosen threshold and its justification.

atoms.statement: Compute accuracy metrics (mAP, precision, recall, F1) on a labeled dataset, either a small proof-set from device 0 or a standard benchmark like COCO val.
atoms.test: Verify that mAP, precision, recall, and F1 scores are calculated against a documented ground-truth labeled dataset.

atoms.statement: Generate a quantitative comparison report including accuracy metrics (mAP, precision, recall, F1) and performance metrics (FPS, latency, detection count).
atoms.test: Review the report for tables/sections detailing mAP, precision, recall, F1, FPS, and latency for both models.

atoms.statement: Save all relevant artifacts, including the raw input clip, annotated before/after frames or video, metrics data (JSON/CSV), configuration snapshots, and a comprehensive report (Markdown/HTML).
atoms.test: Verify that a designated artifact directory contains the raw clip, annotated visual proofs, metrics files, config, and the final report.

atoms.statement: Measure and report the inference cost (latency/FPS) of YOLOv11x, explicitly noting any performance tradeoffs or inability to run in real-time on the target hardware.
atoms.test: Review the report for a dedicated section on YOLOv11x performance, including measured FPS/latency and a clear statement on real-time capability.
